work.title: Hieroglyph
work.description: Collaged layers juxtapose a reproduced Egyptian wall-painting of a seated deity—bearing a solar disc headdress and hieroglyphic register above—with a line-drawn warplane ascending from below. Yellow tape strips run vertically across the composition; compact discs occupy upper corners; a football helmet, iridescent sequin strips, and scattered marbles accumulate at the lower edge.
work.composition: centered iconographic panel with framing bands
